title: Woman by Cherry Blossom Pond
description: A Black woman in an elegant light blue dress and matching hat sits on a large rock beside a pond. She is positioned beneath the branches of a blooming pink cherry blossom tree, with a traditional East Asian pagoda visible in the background across the water.
prompt: A beautiful Black woman wearing an elegant light blue satin dress with a matching wide-brimmed hat sits gracefully on a rock beside a tranquil pond. She is positioned under the branches of a blooming cherry blossom tree with pink flowers. In the background stands a traditional multi-tiered East Asian pagoda surrounded by lush greenery. Soft natural lighting, petals floating on the water, serene garden setting.
